{{Vanilla|Campfire}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Kindling''' is a block used to cook [[food]] without fuel. It replaces the {{MCW|Campfire|campfire}} and is the first cooking station a player can build. It cooks every food an [[oven]] can except [[Pumpkin Curry|pumpkin curry]], [[Popped Chorus Fruit|popped chorus fruit]] and [[Dried Kelp|dried kelp]], and it also dries grass and fires clay.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Kindling is crafted from 2 sticks and 2 logs, and always comes out unlit.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/campfire.json}}</ref> The vanilla campfire recipe (which used coal) is removed.

=== Breaking ===
Kindling always drops itself, unlit, instead of charcoal.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/campfire.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
Kindling has to be lit, for example with [[tinder]] or a [[Fire Starter|fire starter]], before it can cook. Lighting it grants ''Prometheus be Damned''.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/light_campfire.json}}</ref>

=== Cooking ===
{{Main|Cooking}}
Up to four items cook at once, each in 5 seconds (15 seconds for the oven meals), much faster than a vanilla campfire's 30 seconds. It cooks:
* The simple preparations of [[intrinsic]] ingredients, except popped chorus fruit and dried kelp.
* [[Bread]], [[Baked Potato|baked potato]]es, [[Fried Egg|fried egg]]s, [[nopales]], [[molasses]] and cooked meat and fish.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/campfire/molasses.json}}</ref>
* [[Green Curry|Green curry]], [[Japanese Curry|Japanese curry]], [[Paneer Makhani|paneer makhani]] and [[Tonkotsu Ramen|tonkotsu ramen]] from their [[stock]]s.

It also turns short grass and ferns into short dry grass (10 seconds), tall grass and large ferns into tall dry grass, bushes into dead bushes and clay balls into bricks (5 seconds each).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/campfire/short_dry_grass_campfire.json}}</ref> Drying grass grants ''Harvester''.

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Prometheus be Damned'': light kindling using tinder or a fire starter.
* ''Harvester'': use a hoe to harvest grass and dry it on kindling.
